## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] `pnpm validate:rc`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck:all`
- [ ] `pnpm test:coverage`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e`
- [ ] `pnpm build:packages`
- [ ] `pnpm build:examples`
- [ ] `pnpm publish:dry-run` before release changes

## Release

- [ ] Added or updated a changeset when package behavior changed.
- [ ] Updated docs or examples when public APIs changed.
- [ ] Added colocated tests for implementation changes.
